decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1) The proposed hip to gable extension will create an imbalance to the property, which will result in an appearance that is cumbersome and out of keeping with the existing dwelling. This is contrary to policies ENV.B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Planning Department 2003; and the Hounslow Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - The proposed front and rear dormer roof extensions by reason of the siting, size and appearance are not subservient or secondary to the main roof slope within which they are set, resulting in an overall appearance which is cumbersome, incongruous and unrelated to the existing house and surrounding area. This is contrary to policies ENV.B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2004; and the Hounslow Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Erection of dormer window extension to front and rear roof slopes of house.
